clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver sends champions against Arugal. The rogue archmage holds Shadowfang Keep, and his worgen menace threatens the Forsaken’s hold on Silverpine Forest.

Shadowfang Keep rises above the woods, where Archmage Arugal commands the worgen. The Forsaken have made the Sepulcher their base, but Silverpine Forest remains dangerous and fiercely contested. Driven mad by guilt and dark sorcery, Arugal unleashed the feral worgen upon Lordaeron. His ravenous beasts roam the forest paths and hinder Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s efforts to secure the region.

Dalar Dawnweaver knows that hunting worgen across the forest will not end the danger. Their source lies inside Shadowfang Keep. You must breach the old stronghold, fight through Arugal’s worgen brood, and confront the mad wizard in his aerie. His severed head is proof of his death, and his defeat can break his hold over the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.
I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, friend. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.
Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!

clips.title: Progress
paras: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, friend. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
